title: Hollow Engine v2
description: A hollow FM-sine bass drone that morphs across 24 cycles via traveling fm index, ladder filter sweep, and slow vibrato. This v2 keeps the same FM-sine identity but reads clearly as pitched: integer fmh harmonics replace the inharmonic 2.01/3.99 ratios, the bitcrush is tamed so the fundamental sings, and consonant fifth and octave layers reinforce the root.
code:
setcpm(116/4)
stack(
  note("<c1 c1 eb1 <g0 bb0>>*2").s("sine")
    .fm(sine.slow(24).range(2, 13)).fmh("<1 2 3 1 4>/5")
    .penv("<0 0 7 -5>/8").pattack(0.002).pdecay(0.1)
    .lpf(sine.slow(31).range(180, 2600)).resonance(sine.slow(17).range(6, 17)).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(4).lpattack(0.008).lpdecay(0.18)
    .vib("<3 5 7>/8").vibmod(sine.slow(13).range(0.1, 0.9))
    .attack(0.005).decay(0.22).sustain(0.55).release(0.07)
    .shape(0.34).crush("<16 16 14 12>/16")
    .pan(sine.slow(11).range(0.3, 0.7))
    .off(1/4, x => x.add(note(7)).gain(0.32).pan(0.22).crush(16))
    .off(1/8, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.28).pan(0.78).fm(9))
    .delay("0.4:0.375:0.6").room(0.25).gain(0.85)
)
